purpose: Obscure and newly available RISC-V / embedded AI systems with direct local-LLM relevance. Vendor throughput claims are retained with provenance and are not treated as normalized cross-platform benchmarks.

hardware.cpu: 8x X100 high-performance RISC-V cores + 8x A100 AI cores
interfaces: dual USB-C with USB-PD and DisplayPort Alt Mode

vendor_benchmarks.caveat: Sipeed does not provide enough public model, quantization, context, runtime, or power metadata on the indexed product page for normalized comparison.

hardware.model_size_practicality: 32GB unified memory makes many 20B-30B-class 4-bit models capacity-plausible, but usable speed depends on the K3 runtime and operator coverage; do not infer performance from TOPS alone.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Vendor explicitly lists INT4 and promotes 30B LLM inference. Arbitrary GGUF/llama.cpp compatibility should be treated as runtime-dependent until independently verified.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: High-interest experimental RISC-V local-AI node because it combines 32GB memory, 10GbE and dedicated AI compute in Pico-ITX form factor.
hardware.off_grid_suitability: Potentially good compact-node candidate, but no defensible manufacturer whole-board idle/load power measurement was found in this pass; do not score power efficiency from TOPS alone.

pricing.note: Recent third-party channel observation; retained as dated market evidence because the public Sipeed product page does not expose a stable current storefront price.

hardware.product: ALPHA-One 7B LLM Agentic/Generative AI Agent Appliance
hardware.cooling: passive aluminum enclosure with heat pipe contacting SoC

vendor_benchmarks.caveat: PINE64 store gives a current 4.x tok/s figure without full prompt/context/quantization metadata; documentation also records approximately 3.5 tok/s for the Docker path and labels higher native-mode rates as potential improvement.

hardware.model_size_practicality: Designed and shipped specifically around 7B-class local models. PINE64 describes 15B support as a potential future optimization, not verified current capability.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Uses ESWIN-specific model/runtime tooling; do not assume arbitrary GGUF compatibility or llama.cpp NPU acceleration.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Unusually concrete RISC-V edge-AI appliance because it ships with working 7B models and a vendor-reported real token rate rather than TOPS alone.
hardware.off_grid_suitability: Strong experimental off-grid candidate: vendor claims below-30W system consumption and passive cooling, though independent wall-power measurements are still desirable.

pricing.note: PINE Store community price; includes US-plug 12V 3A supply.

hardware.mcu: STM32H5F5 Arm Cortex-M33 at 250MHz, 4MB flash, 1.5MB RAM
operating_systems: Arduino Core on Zephyr for MCU
hardware.llm_support_evidence: Arduino explicitly advertises local LLMs, VLMs, ASR and TTS through pre-optimized Qualcomm AI Hub / Edge Impulse / App Lab paths.
hardware.model_size_practicality: 16GB LPDDR5 is useful for small and medium edge models, but no defensible public model-size ceiling or normalized token-rate benchmark is stored yet.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Qualcomm AI Hub and Edge Impulse provide optimized/quantized deployment paths. Arbitrary GGUF acceleration on the Hexagon NPU is not claimed here.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: High-potential robotics/physical-AI node where deterministic real-time control and local multimodal inference matter more than maximum language-model size.
hardware.off_grid_suitability: Promising due to direct DC input options and integrated edge compute, but no whole-board workload power measurements are yet stored.

pricing.note: Arduino has not published a stable retail price yet.
